segments.an10.66:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā sāriputto magadhesu viharati nālakagāmake.
segments.an10.66:1.2: Atha kho sāmaṇḍakāni paribbājako yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.an10.66:1.3: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho sāmaṇḍakāni paribbājako āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an10.66:2.1: “Kiṃ nu kho, āvuso, sāriputta, imasmiṃ dhammavinaye sukhaṃ, kiṃ dukkhan”ti?
segments.an10.66:2.2: “Anabhirati kho, āvuso, imasmiṃ dhammavinaye dukkhā, abhirati sukhā.
segments.an10.66:2.3: Anabhiratiyā, āvuso, sati idaṃ dukkhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ – gacchantopi sukhaṃ sātaṃ nādhigacchati, ṭhitopi … nisinnopi … sayānopi … gāmagatopi … araññagatopi … rukkhamūlagatopi … suññāgāragatopi … abbhokāsagatopi … bhikkhumajjhagatopi sukhaṃ sātaṃ nādhigacchati.
segments.an10.66:2.14: Anabhiratiyā, āvuso, sati idaṃ dukkhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ.
segments.an10.66:3.1: “Abhiratiyā, āvuso, sati idaṃ sukhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ – gacchantopi sukhaṃ sātaṃ adhigacchati, ṭhitopi … nisinnopi … sayānopi … gāmagatopi … araññagatopi … rukkhamūlagatopi … suññāgāragatopi … abbhokāsagatopi … bhikkhumajjhagatopi sukhaṃ sātaṃ adhigacchati.
segments.an10.66:3.12: Abhiratiyā, āvuso, sati idaṃ sukhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhan”ti.
